From Surface · Price: the target mirrors the puppet's moves only while it can see the puppet.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 10 minutes: carve a puppet copy of a creature you've touched; a puppet carved before a fight lasts through it. 1 action: your puppet strikes itself and falls; its creature, within 30 ft and able to see it, copies the move: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}), and it falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone} on a failure.
  • 5: Surge: the puppet slams itself, then takes 1 action (Stride, Strike, drop an item or drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}); the target takes @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[will|against:stand|basic|traits:incapacitation]{basic Will}, incapacitation), and on a failure must copy the action on its next action; on a critical failure it copies every action the puppet takes on its next turn.
  • 9: The puppet can Impersonate the target, and a target that fails against the surge is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} to the puppet until the start of your next turn.
  • 13: Your puppet knows what its creature knows. Once per 10 minutes, ask it one question it answers truthfully.
  • 17: The target mirrors two actions.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
